ev.q: The Adventures of Ichabod and Mr. Toad is a 1949 American animated anthology film
has a subtle, satirical edge on its comedy which will limit its appreciation to adult audiences
it still has enough action for the children and wit enough for everybody
It is deft and pleasant, and throughout, ironic and goodhearted.
The half-hour length seems ideal for each of the stories
the Ichabod part of Ichabod and Mr. Toad is silly and bumbling
